annotations.title: Live check of the Environment Agency waste carrier register

description: Searches the Environment Agency public register of waste carriers, brokers and dealers (England) live, by registration number (for example CBDU123456) or business name with an optional postcode. Returns each match with its tier (upper tier may carry other people's waste, lower tier only its own), registration and expiry dates, status, address and a link to the register entry, plus links to the Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland registers. Use it for the builder's own registration or a skip, grab or muck away firm. Example: {"name":"Oakline Building","postcode":"LS6 2AB"}.

postcode.description: Narrows a name search to that postcode or area.

name: waste_carrier_check
